Detailed Description

user-definables.

factory defaults are set for maximum comfort and minimum confusion to new users; sometimes at a slight speed penalty. most of these will become run-time configurables at a later date.

Define Documentation

#define CACHE_SLOWER_THAN   2500
 

CACHE_SLOWER_THAN if a directory takes longer than this many miliseconds to process (read, stat, mime, meta, thumbnail, and whatever else), create a persistent cache in the user's home-dir so it will load faster next time.

set to 0 to disable caching altogether.

#define FS_SETS_X_ON_EVERYTHING
 

FS_SETS_X_ON_EVERYTHING undef'd: if "x" bits ("executable") are set on a file, we consider it an executable and never bother with MIME-lookups by file-extension and the like.

slightly faster, but will result in everything looking like an executable when mounting win-partitions or certain CD-Rs. defined: slightly slower, but it will make us look ever so much smarter on imports from Windows and the like where the "executable" bits are set on everything.

#define ICONLIST_FIND_ICON_BY_STRING_RESETS_AFTER   2
 

ICONLIST_FIND_ICON_BY_STRING_RESETS_AFTER when entering the beginning of an icon's label, we jump to that icon.

after not entering a character in "x" seconds, reset that string.

#define THUMBNAIL_IMAGES_SMALLER_THAN   0L
 

THUMBNAIL_IMAGES_SMALLER_THAN evidence will not attempt to create thumbnails for files larger than this size (in bytes).

this will speed up the icon-view. the "tooltip" (balloon info) remains unaffected by this, and will always try to show a preview. set to 0 for no limit.
